descriptions.e12d_encode_radices_8026cc60: Encode a seed's nine mixed-radix digits into one scalar: copy digit 0 into the encoded field, then for each following digit rebuild the product of the lower radices from the static unsigned-short radix table and add digit*product to the encoded field. Finally format the seed through the original formatter with the encoded value passed through the original non-zero helper (value, or 1 when zero) and return the encoded value. Preserve the radix order, digit stride, unsigned arithmetic and the variadic call. Partial seed view; complete original type unknown. No owned initialized data (the radix table and format string are referenced as external original data).
